    Roiter's square alternative from Figure 13 #

    The exact Figure-13 hard branch is stated for morphisms which generate their outer Hom spaces. This file performs the reduction from arbitrary prohibited morphisms to such generators. The two local ingredients are that primitive- projective endomorphism rings are commutative and that, over a commutative endpoint ring, transit or cotransit passes from a generator to every element of its principal two-sided span.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.SplitBasicIdempotents.ProjectiveCategory.end_mul_comm {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {A : Type v} [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [Module.Finite k A] {ι : Type x} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (S : SplitBasicIdempotents) [HasBGRSDistributiveHomStructure k S.ProjectiveCategory] (X : S.ProjectiveCategory) (a b : CategoryTheory.End X) :
    a * b = b * a

    Every endomorphism ring of a chosen primitive projective is commutative. If its radical is nonzero, a maximal radical parameter generates the whole algebra; if the radical vanishes, the split residue map is injective.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RoiterFigure13EAmbient.roiterTransitSquareAlternative {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {A : Type v} [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [Module.Finite k A] {ι : Type x} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (S : SplitBasicIdempotents) [HasBGRSDistributiveHomStructure k S.ProjectiveCategory] (hfinite : MildAlg k A) {X Y Z : S.ProjectiveCategory} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (hfNotC : ¬AllowsCotransit f) (hgNotT : ¬AllowsTransit g) :
    LeftJacobsonSquareAnnihilates f ∨ RightJacobsonSquareAnnihilates g

    Figure 13 proves Roiter's literal square-annihilation alternative for arbitrary morphisms in the split-basic primitive-projective category.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RoiterFigure13EAmbient.full_outer_spans_of_nonzeroJacobsonSandwich {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {A : Type v} [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [Module.Finite k A] {ι : Type x} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (S : SplitBasicIdempotents) [HasBGRSDistributiveHomStructure k S.ProjectiveCategory] (hfinite : MildAlg k A) {X Y Z : S.ProjectiveCategory} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (hfNotC : ¬AllowsCotransit f) (hgNotT : ¬AllowsTransit g) (hsandwich : HasNonzeroJacobsonSandwich f g) :
    twoSidedEndomorphismSpan k f = ⊤ ∧ twoSidedEndomorphismSpan k g = ⊤

    BGRS 4.3(a): a prohibited pair carrying a nonzero middle-radical sandwich has full principal span on both sides. Otherwise a full generator differs by a nonunit middle coefficient, so the displayed sandwich factors through the square of the middle radical and Roiter's alternative kills it.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RoiterFigure13EAmbient.zeroPairRadicalSandwich_full_outer_spans {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {A : Type v} [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [Module.Finite k A] {ι : Type x} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (S : SplitBasicIdempotents) [HasBGRSDistributiveHomStructure k S.ProjectiveCategory] (hfinite : MildAlg k A) {X Y Z : S.ProjectiveCategory} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z} (D : BGRSZeroPairRadicalSandwich f g) :
    twoSidedEndomorphismSpan k D.left = ⊤ ∧ twoSidedEndomorphismSpan k D.right = ⊤

    The source's P_i zero-representative configuration therefore has full outer Hom generators on both sides.
